intro: Six lands ring the Rift: Wave, Flame, Root, Breeze, Soil and Lightning. Each has its own weather, its own creatures, and its own way of doing things.
A creature will follow someone of its own nature, and nobody else. Ask anyone.
Where the six lands meet stands the Citadel. It belongs to none of them, and it has a Master of its own.
hero_intro: You are {hero} of {land}. This spring you were to marry {sweetheart}.
{sweetheart} worked {sw_their} way up to become Master of the Citadel.
{Sw_their} {sw_creature} has never once lost to your {creature}.
Then word came down the road at dusk: six Masters who answer to nobody now hold the Citadel - and {sweetheart}!
You know who leads them. You taught {nem_first} to hold out {nem_their} first lure.
Five lands lie between {land} and the Citadel. Each has a Master of its own, and none of them lets a stranger through without a fight.
You set out, with {creature} at your side.
lord_wins: Not today. Come back when you're stronger.
ally_offers: Let me have a go. {lord} hasn't seen what I can do.

win_specific.clutch: I had you on the ropes. How are you still standing?
win_specific.fast: That was over before I'd even warmed up. I've never lost that fast.
win_specific.uphill: My {e_noun} should have swallowed your {p_noun} whole. It didn't. How?
win_specific.guard: Every time I struck, you were already braced for it. You read me perfectly.
win_specific.plain: You hardly leaned on your {p_noun} at all. That was pure skill.
win_specific.misses: Half blind, and you still kept coming.
win_specific.advantage: Your {p_noun} went straight through my {e_noun}. I never stood a chance.
win_specific.default: You and {creature} move like one. I couldn't find a gap.

win_general: You {folk} folk are {trait} than I gave you credit for.
win_by_ally: Beaten by {ally}, of all people. And {ally_they} follow{ally_s} you?
Then there's more to you than I saw.
tell_quest: You tell {lord} that the Citadel has been taken, and its Master with it.

1: Those six came through here on their way. I've never seen creatures hold a line like that. Not ours. Not anyone's.
3: One of them had a creature that wasn't their nature. I saw it. I've been telling myself I didn't.
4: I've stood at the Citadel's gates. Nothing breaks them. If those six are inside, I'd like to know how.

citadel_intro: Six lands. Six natures. One road left.
The Citadel stands on the lip of the Rift. Up here the creatures won't settle. They feel it too.
Its gates stand open. Nothing is broken. Nothing is burned.
Once we're inside, there's no resting. Whatever hurts us on one floor, we carry to the next.
Each of the six holds a floor.
ally_claims: I know every trick {nem_first} has. This one's mine.
{hero}, call it if you see something I don't.
ally_out: My {creature} is in no state to fight. Someone will have to stand in for me.
sixth_reveal_first: {nem_first} sends out one more creature. A {beater} one.
You're {element}, like me. No {beater} creature would ever follow you!
It doesn't follow me. It keeps the others in line.
sixth_reveal_later: Another one. All six of them, then.
floor_clear: Floor {floor} is clear. There's no time to rest.
floor_lost: The party can't go on. Everyone falls back to the stairs.
final_enter: The top of the Citadel. Night, and the Rift howling overhead. On the platform at the centre of the roof, someone is waiting.
No answer. Only a laugh, quickly smothered.
{sweetheart}? Is that you? Are you all right?
Of course {sw_they}'s all right. I'm only here keeping {sw_them} company.
Let {sw_them} go? {Sw_they} invited me. You're the one who broke in.
What can I say? {nem_first} is a very impressive {nem_man}.
Impressive? I could beat {nem_them} any day.
final_no_creature: You climbed all this way with nothing left to fight me with? Then send me your friends.
hybrid_reveal: Did you think I'd stop at keeping one? Look closer, {hero}.
Half of it is mine. You know whose the other half is.
Whatever you send, it becomes the half that hurts you most.
final_ally_cheer: Then we find something that stands up to both halves. Think, {hero}!
outro: {hybrid} falls. For a moment, nobody moves.
It's over, {nem_first}. How? How did you get it to follow you?
All right. All right! I'll tell you. Just...
{nem_first} runs for the battlements, and jumps.
You reach the edge. Just below it, a narrow ledge. Below that, a ladder, and {nem_first} already halfway down the tower.
{Nem_they} showed me everything. {Nem_they} never once asked what I'd do with it.
Then I watched you cross five lands and climb this tower without any of it.
{Nem_they} thinks it went over that wall with {nem_them}. It didn't. Ask me anything.
It's done. Your companions turn for the stairs, and you with them.
You turn, and walk back to {sw_them}. The others go on down.
I've kept this place alone long enough. Stay.

end.title: THE END
end.stats: Battles lost along the way: {losses}.   Turns fought: {turns}.
end.again: Thank you for playing. Press Enter to return to the title.

menu.new_warning: Beginning again will replace the journey you have saved.
menu.hint: Arrow keys or WASD choose.  Enter confirms.  Esc leaves.
menu.earlier: Go back to an earlier rest point
menu.earlier_ask: Go back to where? Later rest points stay as they are until you reach them again.

home: But first, one last walk through {land}.
The inn will see to your creatures. The market sells what a traveller needs. And in the long growth off the road, there are wild {element} creatures who might yet come with you.
(Press M at any time to look over your creatures, your satchel and your coins.)
One creature won't get you far. The wild ones out in the long growth trust a {element} hand, and they trust it sooner once they're tired.
Five's the most anyone keeps. My uncle tried for six. We don't talk about the barn.
away: Everything that lives here is {land_element} through and through. They'll fight you, stranger. They'll never follow you.
Now and then a {element} creature strays over the border. Lost, mostly. It might be glad of a familiar face.
Six strangers came through last month, bound for the Citadel. Our creatures hit them with everything. It was like hitting a wall.
folk.master: Stay by the inn and the stall and nobody will trouble you. Go on east, and sooner or later {lord} steps out to meet you. Nobody crosses {land} without beating {lord_them}.
folk.master_gone: {lord} is travelling with you? Then the road east is yours.

sign: {land}. Travellers: the town is safe ground. East of it, {master} {lord} challenges all comers. Nobody crosses without beating {lord_them}.
inn_ask: A bed, a fire, and a place for your creatures. Stay a while?
inn_done: Morning. Your creatures are rested, and your journey so far is safely remembered.
market_full: You've no room for that. Your satchel holds eight bundles of three.
market_poor: You haven't the coins for that. Masters pay up when you beat them, and I buy any herbs or Rift shards you find.

found.herb_brewed: A fragrant herb. Willow crushes it into a remedy before you've even put it away.
found.shard: A sliver of the Rift, still faintly warm.
found.chest: A traveller's cache, hidden well. Inside: {loot}.
found.full: There's no room left in your satchel.
found.coins: Coins in the dust, where someone dropped them. {n} of them.
found.bundle: A traveller's bundle, lost off the road. Inside: {loot}.

navigator: There's a way through here. Most people walk straight past it.
gate_shut: The border gate is barred. Nobody crosses without the {master}'s word.
gate_citadel: Beyond the border, the road climbs to the Citadel. Inside there's no resting, and no way back out.
lookout: Hold on. Someone's waiting up ahead.

forecast.wave: Rain on the way. Wave moves will hit harder today.
forecast.flame: A dry, hot wind. Flame moves will hit harder today.
forecast.root: Warm and damp. Growing weather: Root moves will hit harder today.
forecast.breeze: Gusts all day. Breeze moves will hit harder.
forecast.soil: Dust hanging in the air. Soil moves will hit harder today.
forecast.lightning: There's a storm building. Lightning moves will hit harder.

blackout: Your creatures can't go on. You carry them back to where you last rested.
camp: Bram finds a sheltered hollow and builds a fire. Everyone rests, and your journey so far is remembered.
camp_used: One camp to a land. There isn't the stone here for another.
forge: Kael works two shards over the fire until they run together. A charm.

wave.scene: A wall of fire fills the stairway from side to side. The stones around it are scorched black.
wave.done: Water roars up the stair. The fire hisses, sinks and dies.

flame.scene: Thorned vines as thick as a wrist have grown right across the door. They're tinder-dry.
flame.done: The vines catch at once, curl and fall away as ash.

root.scene: The bridge is gone. Across the gap, old roots trail from both edges, grey but not quite dead.
root.done: The roots stir, stretch and knot together into a bridge.

breeze.scene: The hall ahead is thick with choking smoke. Somewhere in it is the way up.
breeze.done: One long breath of wind, and the smoke rolls out through the arrow-slits.

soil.scene: The floor has fallen away into a pit. Loose rubble is heaped at its edge.
soil.done: The rubble shifts, settles and packs itself into steps.

lightning.scene: An iron door, three hands thick. Beside it, copper coils run down into a silent machine.
lightning.done: The coils sing. Deep in the wall, gears turn, and the door grinds open.

blocked_ask: Whose creatures can clear the way?
blocked_fail: {trainer}'s creatures strain at it. Nothing gives, and the effort leaves them tired.
trial_start: This is a short taste of the journey: one Master, one floor of the Citadel, and what waits at the top.
trial_bridge: Four more Masters, a great many miles and a great many battles later...

trial_end.title: ENTWINED
trial_end.line: That was a taste. The full journey has six lands to walk, wild creatures to befriend, and a Citadel that fights back.
trial_end.again: Press Enter to return to the title.

wave: Spots ways through that other travellers walk straight past.
flame: Forges two Rift shards into a charm. Ask from your pack.
root: Turns any herb you find into a remedy on the spot.
breeze: Sees trouble on the road before it sees you.
soil: Makes camp once in each land: a full rest, wherever you are. Ask from your pack.
lightning: Reads the day's weather, and which nature it favours.

camp_self: You find a sheltered hollow and build a fire. Everyone rests, and your journey so far is remembered.
forge_self: You work two shards over the fire until they run together. A charm.

quit.saved: Your journey is remembered from the last time you rested.

ready.no: {hero}, I'll say it plainly. I don't think we're ready for that place. Not yet.
ready.rest: We'll get no rest in there. Best we go in fresh, and as strong as we can make ourselves.

own_first: You first, {ally}. Alone. Your friends can wait until one of yours is down.

breather.ask: The stairs are quiet. A moment to see to the creatures before the next floor.

heal.which: {trainer} can mend one of {their} own. Which?
heal.none: {trainer} has no healing touch left. Only a proper rest, or an elixir, brings it back.
heal.no_need: None of {trainer}'s creatures needs it. It can't wake one that has fainted.
heal.done: {trainer} lays a hand on {creature}. It recovers {n} HP.
heal.elixir_who: Whose healing touch should the elixir restore?
heal.elixir_done: {trainer}'s healing touch is as strong as ever.
heal.elixir_full: {trainer}'s healing touch is already at its strongest.
heal.which_you: You can mend one of your own. Which?
heal.none_you: You have no healing touch left. Only a proper rest, or an elixir, brings it back.
heal.no_need_you: None of your creatures needs it. It can't wake one that has fainted.
heal.done_you: You lay a hand on {creature}. It recovers {n} HP.
heal.elixir_done_you: Your healing touch is as strong as ever.
heal.elixir_full_you: Your healing touch is already at its strongest.

market.lures_about: Tempt a weakened wild {element} creature to join whoever of your party shares its nature.
market.sell_about: I'll buy anything in your satchel. Herbs and Rift shards turn up off the road: 4 coins a herb, 6 a shard.

1: Not one of these doors has been locked.

outro_stairs: There you are. We almost thought you were staying.
I am. My place is here now. Go back to your lands.
But don't forget to come back in the spring.

stall.none: {El} lures. You'd want a {El}master with you for those. {El} creatures won't come to anyone else.
stall.room_you: I see you've {n} with you. Room for {left} more, then. Five creatures is the most anyone keeps.
stall.room_other: {El} lures? They'll be for {name}, then. {name} has {n}, so there's room for {left} more.
stall.full_you: You sure? Looks like you've already got five creatures. Any more than that and they start playing up.
stall.full_other: You sure? {name}'s already got five creatures. Any more than that and they start playing up.

wild_note.stranger: A wild {El} creature. It'll fight, but it won't follow anyone travelling with you.
wild_note.yours: A wild {El} creature: your kind. Wear it down, and it might take a lure.
wild_note.theirs: A wild {El} creature: one of {name}'s kind. Wear it down, and it might take a lure from {them}.

lure_mine: Here, let me. It's one of mine.
joins_kind: The {El} creatures of {land} have someone to follow now. {lord} has room for {left} more.
joins_kind_full: The {El} creatures of {land} have someone to follow now, though {lord} already keeps five.
joins_coins: {lord} presses a purse into your hand: {coins} coins for the road.
blocked_fail_you: Your creatures strain at it. Nothing gives, and the effort leaves them tired.
sign_open: {land}. The road east is open, by {master} {lord}'s word.
sign_home: {land}. East: the border. Every land beyond has a Master of its own, and nobody crosses a land without beating its Master.
arrive: {land}. The town ahead is safe ground. Somewhere east of it, {master} {lord} will step into the road, and nobody leaves {land} without beating {lord_them}.
ally_out_answer: A pity, {ally}. I wanted it to be you. Send me whoever you have left, then.
